name: love(BATTLE)doll
source:
a sentient robotic love doll is brought into a world of tournaments, destruction, and battle 

you really aren't made for this, but that's okay!
it's all foreplay

[From [url=https://ophanimkei.itch.io/love-battle-doll]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個有自我意識的情趣機器人偶，被帶進了一個充斥著錦標賽、破壞與戰鬥的世界。

你還真不是為了幹這個才被造出來的，不過沒關係！
這全是前戲。
